body:
Experienced with most drugs but not really explored the area of research chemicals much yet very interesting though. Friday Night all by myself.
Intially I eyeballed 100mg as I had 500mg. Split my 100mg into 4 equalish lines.
11:00pm First I vaped about (25mg) in bowl held smoke in for as long as had another hit from same bowl (mild comeup kinda did feel stimulated)
11:30 Snorted a line a bit smaller than 25mg (noticed the come up more mild euphoria)
11:50 Snorted another (35mg) line coz I started to feel edgy wanted some more (very cokey edginess to it that I dont partically like)
12:00 Midnight only got a small amount left I guess (15mg) out, so get out another crystal crush it up to a fine powder I reckon there was at least (45-50mg) maybe more was quite a big line though :) done it felt good proper rushed and pretty sweaty  got on the computer and had a little sort out, tidy up.
12:30 Vaped a large amount of crushed crystal easily (50mg) got a proper nice euphoria like flow go through me, this stuff is very similar to coke imo obviously the real deal is better depending on what quality u get, but it seems very similar to coke more in the fact that I just want to keep doing more LOL. By the way this is somebody who is not a regular stimulant user anymore and coke nevr was my buzz, MDMA and a little speed used to do the job for me :)
Overall not bad I reckon if u like ur stims and definitely cost effective! To be quite honest I prefer the effect and high of Methiopropamine (aot less irritable)
These are all just my reflections on what I experienced and I am not endorsing consuming this at all!
